component.name: Igareck AntiDPI
component.summary: Public TLS strategies and terminal shell for Bol-Van Zapret2
Публичные TLS-стратегии и терминальная оболочка для Zapret2

description.p: Terminal application with 484 public Golden and Silver strategies for local IPv4 TCP traffic on Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora).
The official Bol-Van engine is downloaded and built during installation. Root privileges are required for NFQUEUE processing.
